'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Foreign involvement in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[India–Russia relations]]
***Two [[India]]ns recruited by the [[Russian Ground Forces|Russian army]] are killed in [[Ukraine]] with the [[Ministry of External Affairs (India)|Indian foreign ministry]] urging Moscow to quickly return all Indian nationals who are serving in the [[Russia]]n army. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cv225e8dpdgo (BBC News)]
**[[Kryvyi Rih strikes (2022–present)|Kryvyi Rih strikes]]
***Nine people are killed and 26 others are injured in a Russian [[airstrike]] on [[Kryvyi Rih]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-missile-attack-kills-6-injures-11-ukraines-kryvyi-rih-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)] [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/8-killed-in-russian-strike-Fon-zelenskys-hometown-in-ukraine-5876391 (NDTV)]
**[[Kyiv strikes (2022–present)|Kyiv strikes]]
***Russia launches a wave of [[cruise missile]]s and [[drone warfare|drone attacks]] at [[Kyiv]]. Ukraine claims to have intercepted all missiles and drones, although debris did cause some damage to infrastructure. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russia-launches-missile-drone-attack-kyiv-ukraines-military-says-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
***[[Israel]] kills three [[Hezbollah]] fighters and Taleb Abdullah, a senior commander, in southern [[Lebanon]]. Hezbollah retaliates by launching over 250 rockets towards [[Northern District (Israel)|northern Israel]], the most the group has sent in the war. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/170-rockets-fired-at-north-after-most-senior-hezbollah-officer-killed-in-idf-strike/ (''Times of Israel'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-lebanon-kills-four-including-senior-hezbollah-commander-2024-06-11/ (Reuters)]
*[[Impact of war on children]], [[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**The [[United Nations]] adds the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] and the [[Rapid Support Forces]] to its list of offenders for violating [[children's rights]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cv223vlerdvo (BBC News)]
*[[Nagorno-Karabakh conflict]]
**Russian soldiers complete their withdrawal from the [[Nagorno-Karabakh]] region of [[Azerbaijan]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2024/06/12/russian-peacekeepers-complete-withdrawal-from-nagorno-karabakh-a85385 (''The Moscow Times'')]
*[[Red Sea crisis]]
**The [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] strike and sink the [[Greece|Greek]]-owned, [[Liberia]]n-flagged cargo ship ''Tutor'' with an [[unmanned surface vehicle]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/merchant-ship-hit-by-small-vessel-red-sea-ukmto-says-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**Sixteen [[Syrian Army|Syrian soldiers]], including an officer, are killed in [[Homs Governorate]] in a minefield laid by [[Islamic State]] militants and in an attack by the Islamic State. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/06/12/isis-kills-16-syrian-soldiers-monitor (Al Arabiya)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Papoura Hill Circular Structure]]
**The [[Ministry of Culture and Sports (Greece)|Greek Ministry of Culture]] announces the discovery of a large [[Bronze Age]]-era [[Minoan civilization|Minoan]] architectural construction used between 2000–1700 BC at the construction site of the [[Kasteli Airport]] in [[Crete]]. [https://apnews.com/article/greece-crete-archaeology-airport-minoan-e1bca3960994b42ef2ec30676a2ae188 (AP)] 
*The [[Royal Canadian Geographical Society]] announces that a [[Canada|Canadian]]-led team has located the wreckage of ''[[Quest (ship)|Quest]]'', the polar exploration ship of the [[Shackleton–Rowett Expedition]] off the coast of [[Labrador]], [[Newfoundland and Labrador]], Canada. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/canadian-led-team-finds-ship-that-polar-explorer-shackleton-died-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**The [[Moscow Exchange]] suspends all trading in [[United States dollar|US dollars]] and [[Euro|euros]] in response to increased sanctions by the [[European Union]] and the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/moscow-exchange-stop-trading-dollars-after-latest-us-sanctions-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Mangaf building fire]]
** 50 people are killed and 56 are injured in a fire at a building housing foreign workers in [[Mangaf]], [[Kuwait]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/least-35-people-killed-fire-southern-kuwait-state-media-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Kasai River disaster]]
** At least 86 people are killed after a boat carrying 271 passengers capsizes on a river near [[Kinshasa]], [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-boat-accident-9da3326e15d123b9c62a902e792f9302 (AP)]
*Several people are injured and 25 shops are destroyed in a fire in [[Manama Souq]], [[Bahrain]]. [https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/bahrain/25-shops-destroyed-by-major-fire-in-old-manama-market-several-injured-1.1718214169442 (Gulfnews)]
*The [[National Weather Service]] issues a rare [[Flash flood warning|Flash Flood Emergency]] in southern [[Florida]], [[United States]], for life-threatening flooding conditions only expected once every 500 to 1,000 years. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/southern-florida-receives-record-rainfall-flash-flooding-500-1000-year-rcna156700 (NBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Armenia–Russia relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Armenia|Armenian Prime Minister]] [[Nikol Pashinyan]] announces that [[Armenia]] will withdraw from the [[Collective Security Treaty Organization]] amid deteriorating relations with [[Russia]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2024/06/12/armenia-to-leave-russian-led-collective-security-treaty-organisation (Euronews)]
*[[Moldova–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] imposes sanctions on [[Evghenia Guțul]], the pro-[[Russia]]n [[Governor of Gagauzia|governor]] of [[Moldova]]'s [[Gagauzia]] region. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us-sanctions-pro-russia-governor-moldovas-gagauzia-region-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**The [[United States]] expands secondary sanctions on foreign financial institutions that conducted business with more than 4,500 US-[[Sanctions involving Russia|sanctioned]] [[Russia|Russian]] entities. [https://www.ft.com/content/1ba434bb-e579-4819-977b-cff6b6b98ecc (''Financial Times'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Killing of Peter R. de Vries]]
**A court in the [[Netherlands]] sentences three men to up to 28 years in prison for the murder of reporter [[Peter R. de Vries]] in 2021, and three other men to 14 years for aiding in the murder. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/killers-dutch-crime-reporter-jailed-up-28-years-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Mexico–United States border crisis]]
**The [[American Civil Liberties Union]] files a lawsuit in federal court against the [[Biden administration]] for [[US President]] [[Joe Biden]]'s new [[A Proclamation on Securing the Border|presidential directive]] which limits migrants seeking asylum at the [[Mexico–United States border]]. [https://www.npr.org/2024/06/12/nx-s1-5003722/aclu-sues-over-biden-border-executive-action (NPR)]
*The [[Oklahoma Supreme Court]] dismisses a lawsuit by the last [[Tulsa race massacre]] survivors seeking reparations. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/wireStory/oklahoma-supreme-court-dismisses-lawsuit-tulsa-race-massacre-111064374 (ABC News)]
*A man in [[Hudson, Florida|Hudson]], [[Florida]], United States fatally shoots a family of four with a [[9 mm]] gun before burning their bodies in a fire pit. The perpetrator was identified as 25-year-old Rory John Graeme Atwood.[https://www.wtsp.com/article/news/crime/pasco-family-murders-hudson-fire-pit/67-a6b950e9-b0de-4208-846e-3409de773a86 (WTSP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Law of Bases and Starting Points for the Freedom of Argentines]]
**The [[Argentine Senate]] passes an extensive economic reform bill package proposed by President [[Javier Milei]], decided by a 36–36 vote, with the tie broken by [[Vice president of Argentina|Vice President]] [[Victoria Villarruel]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-senate-passes-milei-reform-bill-2024-06-13/ (Reuters)]
**[[2024 Argentina protests]]
***Anti-government protestors clash with police outside the [[Palace of the Argentine National Congress|National Congress Palace]] in [[Buenos Aires]], [[Argentina]], after the reform bill's passing. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/argentine-riot-police-disperse-protesters-with-water-cannons-and-tear-gas-ahead-of-key-senate-vote-1.6924120 (CTV)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/argentina-senate-passes-milei-reform-bill-2024-06-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 Armenian protests]]
**Dozens of demonstrators are injured in [[Yerevan]], [[Armenia]], after police fire stun grenades at an anti-government rally outside the [[National Assembly Building of Armenia|National Assembly Building]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2024/06/12/dozens-injured-in-armenia-after-police-clashed-with-anti-government-protesters (Al-Arabiya)]
*[[2024 New Caledonia unrest]]
**[[President of France|French president]] [[Emmanuel Macron]] suspends electoral reforms in [[New Caledonia]] amid riots in the territory. [https://www.reuters.com/world/electoral-reform-new-caledonia-is-suspended-says-french-president-macron-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[2024 South African general election]]
**[[South Africa]]'s [[Inkatha Freedom Party]] says that it will join a unity government with the [[African National Congress]] and the [[Democratic Alliance (South Africa)|Democratic Alliance]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/south-africas-ifp-join-anc-da-unity-government-ifp-leader-2024-06-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Joe Biden classified documents incident]]
**[[United States Attorney General|U.S. attorney general]] [[Merrick Garland]] is found in [[Contempt of Congress|contempt]] by the [[United States House of Representatives]] for refusing to comply with [[subpoena]]s. [https://www.nytimes.com/2024/06/12/us/politics/house-garland-attorney-general-biden-contempt.html (''The New York Times'')]
*The [[France|French]] [[The Republicans (France)|Republicans party]] votes unanimously to remove party leader [[Éric Ciotti]] for attempting to form an [[electoral alliance]] with [[Marine Le Pen]]'s far-right [[National Rally]] party. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/6/12/french-conservatives-remove-leader-eric-ciotti-over-far-right-election-pact (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Artemis program]]
**[[Armenia]] signs the [[Artemis Accords]] at a [[NASA Headquarters]] ceremony, becoming the 43rd country to join the [[United States|American]]-led effort to explore the [[Moon]]. [https://spacenews.com/armenia-signs-artemis-accords/ (Space News)]
